title: The School Trip That Should Have Been Cancelled
summary: An interactive branching story for B1 English learners aged 11–15. Students make choices, encounter increasingly disastrous situations and discover different endings. Play it online, or download the PDF version.
audience: B1 English learners aged 11–15. Content note: contains toilet humour, sewage and gross-out comedy. Best suited to younger teenagers who enjoy deliberately disgusting humour.
image_alt: Illustration from the story: a battered minibus in heavy rain with a green smell drifting out of its door and a manhole cover lifting in the road beside a traffic cone.
